input:
CATEGORY: 没 + V., no 了 (Coherence: temporality)
definition: After 没/没有 for a non-occurring action, do not add 了 to the action verb.

HER NOTES IN THIS CATEGORY (3 distinct):
2 | no了in “没+V.”
1 | 没+ V.
1 | 没 +V., no了, the verb is an action verb

HER CORRECTIONS (4 of 4):
[shennong_samples#1/f9/p0/k0/e0] 神农没死[-了]  || her note: 没+ V.
[shennong_samples#21/f5/p1/k0/e0] 所以他没死[-了]  || her note: no了in “没+V.”
[shennong_samples#38/f2/p1/k0/e1] 可是他没有吃[-了]  || her note: no了in “没+V.”
[shennong_samples#25/f7/p3/k0/e0] 和他[没病了→病好了]  || her note: 没 +V., no了, the verb is an action verb

output.rule: After 没/没有 with an action verb for an action that did not happen, use 没 + V. and do not add 了.
output.explanation_template: <wrong> → <correct>: this action did not happen, so use 没 + V. with no 了 (no了in “没+V.”).

examples.explanation: 没死了 → 没死: this action did not happen, so use 没 + V. with no 了.
没有吃了 → 没有吃: this action did not happen, so use 没 + V. with no 了.
没病了 → 病好了: 病 is not an action verb; use 病好了 for “got better.”

output.not_an_error: This rule is for 没/没有 + an action verb. Do not apply it when the word after 没 is not an action verb, as in 没病了.
